# Patient RX System v2.0.60

## Dashboard Drilldowns and Patient Filter Refinement

- Fixed the Dashboard Pending Deliveries full-page link so it opens RX Records filtered to pending workflow records.
- Added RX Records Workflow Status filtering and sortable Workflow Status data list behavior.
- Added Patient Management missing-information filters for clinic, default pharmacy, patient transport, and pharmacy transport.
- Added cascading Patient Management relationship filters so selected clinics, pharmacies, and transport companies narrow the remaining combo options to related patients.
- Fixed Dashboard RX drilldown workflow progress bars so partially completed records no longer display as 100% complete.

## Database Impact

- No database schema migration.
- No production data transformation.
- Rollback to v2.0.59 should be package-only unless production users create unrelated data after deployment.

## Validation

- Development JavaScript syntax checks passed for changed dashboard/patient files and controller code.
- Changed EJS views compiled successfully.
- Staging config and smoke checks passed before promotion.
- Development preview on port 3000 loaded successfully.
